name: Transition Projects - SSVF (Supportive Services for Veteran Families)
description: Rapid rehousing and homelessness prevention for veterans and their families.
eligibility_summary: Served in U.S. Military; experiencing or at risk of homelessness; low-income.
application_method: Call 855-425-5544 or complete online referral form.
notes: CARF accredited program.

name: Janus Youth - Access Center
description: Single point-of-entry for youth seeking services through Portland’s Homeless Youth Continuum.
eligibility_summary: Ages 16-24; experiencing homelessness in Multnomah County.
notes: Mobile program available 365 days a year.

name: Janus Youth - Porch Light Shelter
description: Emergency shelter for youth with meals, showers, and hygiene amenities.
application_method: Self-refer at door between 9:00 pm and 5:00 am.
notes: Beds are first come, first served. LGBTQ affirmative.

name: Janus Youth - Yellow Brick Road
description: Street outreach program engaging youth experiencing homelessness.
who_it_helps: Youth experiencing homelessness on the streets.
eligibility_summary: Youth on the streets of Portland.
notes: Operates every night of the year.

name: YWCA Clark County - SafeChoice Domestic Violence Program
description: Emergency shelter and advocacy for survivors of domestic violence.
eligibility_summary: Fleeing domestic violence; prioritizes Clark County survivors.
notes: Includes safety planning and support groups.

name: Clark County Veterans Assistance Fund
description: Emergency financial assistance for rent, utilities, and other needs.
eligibility_summary: Honorable/General discharge; Clark County resident for 12 months; income <200% poverty.
application_method: Apply in person at 1305 Columbia St, Suite 100, Vancouver.
notes: Applications accepted M-F 9am-4pm.

name: Bradley Angle - Emergency Shelter
description: Confidential emergency shelter for survivors of domestic violence.
who_it_helps: Survivors of domestic violence and their children.
notes: First DV shelter on the West Coast.

name: Raphael House of Portland - Emergency Shelter
description: Confidential emergency shelter for survivors of domestic violence.
who_it_helps: Survivors of domestic violence and their children.
notes: Provides housing advocacy and support services.

name: New Avenues for Youth - Drop-In Center
description: Basic needs and connections to housing for youth.
eligibility_summary: Ages 14-24; experiencing or at risk of homelessness.
notes: Provides meals, showers, and laundry.

name: Outside In - Youth Housing
description: Transitional and permanent housing for youth.
notes: Focus on LGBTQ+ and marginalized youth.

name: Independent Living Resources - Housing Advocacy
description: Advocacy and information for people with disabilities seeking housing.
notes: Provides peer support and skills training.

name: The Community for Positive Aging - Housing Assistance
description: Information and assistance for seniors navigating housing options.
notes: Formerly Hollywood Senior Center.

name: VA Portland Health Care - Homeless Veteran Care
description: Comprehensive services for homeless veterans including HUD-VASH vouchers.
who_it_helps: Veterans experiencing or at risk of homelessness.
eligibility_summary: Veteran status; homeless or at risk.
notes: CRRC is the Community Resource and Referral Center.

name: Area Agency on Aging and Disabilities of SW WA - Housing Info
description: Information and assistance for seniors and people with disabilities.
who_it_helps: Seniors and adults with disabilities in SW Washington.
notes: Serves Clark, Klickitat, Skamania, Cowlitz, and Wahkiakum counties.

name: REACH Community Development - Affordable Housing
description: Develops and manages affordable housing with waitlists.
application_method: Check website for open waitlists and apply online.
notes: Waitlists open periodically for specific properties.

name: Impact NW - Deposit Assistance
description: Help with move-in costs and security deposits.
application_method: Call 211 for referral to Impact NW.
notes: Availability depends on current funding cycles.

name: Portland Homeless Family Solutions - Family Shelter
description: Emergency shelter and rapid rehousing for families.
eligibility_summary: Families with at least one minor child.
notes: Operates the Family Village shelter.

name: Human Solutions (Our Just Future) - Deposit Assistance
description: Move-in assistance for families transitioning to housing.
eligibility_summary: Families with children; Multnomah County resident.
notes: Part of the Homeless Family System of Care.

name: Native American Youth and Family Center (NAYA) - Housing
description: Culturally specific rent and housing assistance.
eligibility_summary: Income-based; focus on Native American community.
notes: Provides wrap-around services and advocacy.

name: El Programa Hispano Católico - Housing Services
description: Culturally specific rent assistance and housing advocacy.
notes: Bilingual services available.

name: Urban League of Portland - Housing Department
description: Culturally specific rent assistance and eviction prevention.
who_it_helps: African American and other underserved communities.
notes: Focus on housing stability and advocacy.

name: Catholic Charities - Housing Transitions
description: Rent assistance and case management for women and families.
notes: Provides specialized support for refugees and immigrants.

name: Council for the Homeless - Deposit Assistance
description: Assistance with move-in costs for Clark County residents.
notes: Funds are extremely limited.

name: Janus Youth - The Nest
description: Short-term shelter for youth ages 16-24.
notes: Focus on stability and long-term housing.

name: Outside In - Street Outreach
description: Outreach to homeless youth providing basic needs and referrals.
notes: Provides medical and mental health referrals.

name: Raphael House - Advocacy Center
description: Legal advocacy and support for survivors of domestic violence.
notes: Assists with restraining orders and housing rights.

name: Bradley Angle - Economic Empowerment
description: Financial assistance and education for DV survivors.
notes: Includes credit building and rent support.

name: YWCA Clark County - Independent Youth Housing Program
description: Housing support for youth aging out of foster care.
notes: Provides rental subsidies and case management.

name: Clark County Veterans Assistance Center - Outreach
description: Outreach to homeless veterans in Clark County.
notes: Provides gear, food, and connections to housing.
